_comment: Topology-B (per-tile AFE, '_pt') package delta for generate.py. Written 2026-09-06 by B3; the generator branch that reads it landed the same day. This file owns the die-row geometry and the bonded/unbonded split, generate.py owns the ball numbers, and _buildPackageData cross-checks pad count, electrode net names, rail names, the unbonded set and the per-island bonded flag against its own ball map with a FATAL on any disagreement.
_digitalDelta: R1 + S1 (2026-09-06). Pins 1-22 (W) and 51-71 (E) are unchanged from castalia-lqfp100, name for name, and the west/east die-side pad coordinates are unchanged too. The SOUTH row changes: eleven digital pads (GPIO3 bits 3-7, VDDPST, VSSPST and the four TAP pins) move to the north row as one coordinate-placed digital island, the south digital block becomes fifteen placed pads (x = 1157.5 + 25 i) on balls 31-45, and its last two balls carry a NEW fourth I/O supply pair PAD_VDDPST_3 / PAD_VSSPST_3. The _pt padlist still copies A's LEFT and RIGHT lists verbatim and places the analog pads by coordinate rather than through place_side, which would have re-centred a row.
_northBandDelta: castalia-lqfp100 puts one 16-pad analog band on pins 76-91 with ONE analog domain. Topology B has no such band: 76-81 and 95-100 are the two north corner islands, 82-83 the shared bias-generator supply, and 84-94 the eleven relocated south digital pads. No north ball is NC.
_removedPinsNote: The castalia-lqfp100 afe2 band AVDD 76 / AVSS 77 / CE,WE,RE_0..3 78-89 / ATP0 90 / ATP1 91. All sixteen are re-assigned below.

islands._pinNote: R1: balls 82-83, not 87-88. At 87-88 this island splits the eleven relocated digital pads into a 5-ball and a 6-ball run and only one of the two can hold the north row's VDDPST/VSSPST pair; moved against the TR island's ring cut, the digital run is contiguous and carries its own supply. Segment count is unchanged at five.

islands._mirrorNote: hart2 is placed MY, so tile-local x maps to chip x reversed and the island reads ATP,RE,WE,CE,AVSS,AVDD left to right.

islands._pinNote: R1 gives this island package fingers. S1 (2026-09-06, report B7-1) then un-bonds its ATP pad: the DIE pad stays exactly where it is and the padlist carries it at `pin 0`, so the channel keeps its analog test point for probe and chip-on-board work, and the freed ball goes to the south digital segment's new VDDPST/VSSPST pair (balls 44-45). Without that pair the segment's eleven PDUW16SDGZ_G drivers have no 2.5 V I/O supply at all.

islands._mirrorNote: hart4 is placed R180, same x reversal as hart2.
islands._pinNote: R1 gives this island package fingers. S1 (2026-09-06, report B7-1) then un-bonds its ATP pad: the DIE pad stays exactly where it is and the padlist carries it at `pin 0`, so the channel keeps its analog test point for probe and chip-on-board work, and the freed ball goes to the south digital segment's new VDDPST/VSSPST pair (balls 44-45). Without that pair the segment's eleven PDUW16SDGZ_G drivers have no 2.5 V I/O supply at all.

blocker.claim: The twelve south-corner analog pads have no LQFP-100 fingers. The south edge carries 24 digital pads against 25 fingers; adding 12 analog pads needs 36.
blocker.whyTopologyAIsUnaffected: A puts all 16 of its analog pads on the north edge, which carries no digital pad at all.

resolutions.R1: Move 11 south digital pads (P3_3..P3_7, VDDPST_1, VSSPST_1, TCK, TMS, TDI, TDO) to the north row and drop ATP_2/ATP_3. South = 13 digital + 10 analog = 23; north = 12 + 2 + 11 + a north VDDPST/VSSPST pair = 27, so two of the eleven must instead go to the west or east spares (23-25, 72-75). Costs a re-centred south row (13 pads move), a new package model, and a north digital island with its own PRCUTA_G bracket.
resolutions.R2: Move to a 144-pin QFP (36 pins/side). South takes 24 + 12 = 36 exactly, no digital pad moves, no ATP dropped. Recommended if a package change is acceptable.
resolutions.R3: Ship the two south channels unbonded (probe / chip-on-board). Two of four channels are then wire-out only; the die is unchanged.

_s1Note: RESOLUTION S1, LIVE (coordinator, 2026-09-06). ATP_2 and ATP_3 carry packagePin null: they are DIE PADS WITH NO PACKAGE FINGER, not deleted pads. This file still lists 26 analog die pads and the padlist still places 26; 24 of them have balls. The two fingers bought the south pad-ring segment its VDDPST/VSSPST pair (B7-1). platform/common/python/generate.py's castalia-lqfp100-pt branch cross-checks this file ball for ball and FATALs if the bonded/unbonded split here and there disagree.
